prep.ui.ring.label: Readiness {pct}
prep.ui.cta.continueEyebrow: Pick up where you left off
prep.ui.early.note.one: You started before {month}, so you are going through the plan at your own pace. On 1 {month}, in {n} day, it starts again from day 1 so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.early.note.other: You started before {month}, so you are going through the plan at your own pace. On 1 {month}, in {n} days, it starts again from day 1 so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.wait.title: You have reached day {total}
prep.ui.wait.note.one: You have been through every day of the plan. Catch up on any day you missed and keep up your salah and Quran check-ins. On 1 {month}, in {n} day, the plan starts again from day 1 so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.wait.note.other: You have been through every day of the plan. Catch up on any day you missed and keep up your salah and Quran check-ins. On 1 {month}, in {n} days, the plan starts again from day 1 so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.begun.label: day of {month}
prep.ui.begun.body: Ramadan has begun. May Allah accept your fasting, your prayers and your Quran.
prep.ui.readonly.title: Your plan is now closed
prep.ui.readonly.body: Ramadan has begun, so the plan can no longer be ticked. You can still look back on any day and read your reflections.
prep.ui.complete.title: You completed your Ramadan prep
prep.ui.complete.body: You steadied your salah, drew closer to the Quran and prepared your heart. Keep these habits going, and may Allah let you reach Ramadan.
prep.ui.complete.titlePartial: You reached the end of your prep
prep.ui.complete.bodyPartial: You made it to the last day. Every step counts: hold on to what helped you most, and may Allah let you reach Ramadan.
prep.ui.complete.again: Your plan starts again on 1 {month}, so you can go through it once more in the run-up to Ramadan.
prep.ui.intro.last.one: Your prep for Ramadan {year} AH: {done} of {n} prompt done. Starting again begins a fresh plan for the coming Ramadan.
prep.ui.intro.last.other: Your prep for Ramadan {year} AH: {done} of {n} prompts done. Starting again begins a fresh plan for the coming Ramadan.
prep.ui.intro.bestTime.one: The best time to start is 1 {month}, about {total} days before Ramadan: that is in {n} day. If you start now, you go through the plan at your own pace, and it starts again on 1 {month} so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.intro.bestTime.other: The best time to start is 1 {month}, about {total} days before Ramadan: that is in {n} days. If you start now, you go through the plan at your own pace, and it starts again on 1 {month} so that day {total} falls on the eve of Ramadan.
prep.ui.intro.closed: Ramadan has begun. Ramadan Prep opens again after Ramadan, to help you prepare for the next one.
prep.ui.how.checkSub.one: {n} question shows where to focus first.
prep.ui.how.checkSub.other: {n} questions show where to focus first.
prep.ui.how.dailySub: Each day has a theme, small prompts to act on, a motivation and a reflection.
prep.ui.how.checkinsSub: Tick each prayer you pray on time and log your Quran reading toward a target that grows each week.
prep.ui.assess.title: Readiness check
prep.ui.assess.hint: Answer honestly. This is only to help you plan.
prep.ui.assess.retakeHint: Your new answers are saved when you tap See my result. Going back keeps your earlier answers.
prep.ui.assess.none: The readiness check is not available yet. You can start the plan without it.

prep.ui.result.focusBody: Prompts in these areas are marked Focus in your plan.
prep.ui.result.strongTitle: A strong base in every area
prep.ui.result.strongBody: None of your areas scored below {pct}. Keep each one steady and use the plan to go deeper.
prep.ui.result.planTitle.one: {n} day, one step at a time
prep.ui.result.planTitle.other: {n} days, one step at a time

prep.ui.salah.beforeFajr: It is before Fajr, so your ticks still count for {day}.

prep.ui.quran.chartMinutes.other: Quran reading in the last 7 days: {n} minutes

prep.ui.quran.growMinutes: Your target grows a little each week, building up to about 40 minutes a day for Ramadan.
prep.ui.quran.shared: Pages logged here also count in the Quran tab.
prep.ui.catch.title: Catch up on your focus
prep.ui.catch.body: You joined the plan on day {n}. These earlier days have prompts in your focus areas, and you can still do them.
prep.ui.catch.more.one: {n} more earlier day with focus prompts is in your plan below.
prep.ui.catch.more.other: {n} more earlier days with focus prompts are in your plan below.
prep.ui.catch.days.one: {n} earlier day has prompts in your focus areas. Start with day {day}.
prep.ui.catch.days.other: {n} earlier days have prompts in your focus areas. Start with day {day}.
prep.ui.tracks.title: Your progress by area
prep.ui.plan.title: My Ramadan plan
prep.ui.plan.intro: Write your intentions, gather the duas you want to make, and plan any fasts you still need to make up before Ramadan.
prep.ui.plan.goalPh1: e.g. Pray all five prayers on time
prep.ui.plan.goalPh2: e.g. Read the Quran every day with understanding
prep.ui.plan.goalPh3: e.g. Mend ties with my family
prep.ui.plan.duaHint: Keep this list close and return to it in the last ten nights.
prep.ui.qada.none: Add any Ramadan fasts you still need to make up.
prep.ui.qada.left.one: {n} fast still to make up before Ramadan.
prep.ui.qada.left.other: {n} fasts still to make up before Ramadan.
prep.ui.day.title: Day {n}
prep.ui.day.notStarted: Start your prep to tick off these prompts.
prep.ui.day.readonly: Ramadan has begun, so this plan is now closed. You can still read it.
prep.ui.day.opensIn.one: These prompts open tomorrow, on day {day}. You can read ahead now.
prep.ui.day.opensIn.other: These prompts open in {n} days, on day {day}. You can read ahead now.
prep.ui.empty.title: The 30-day plan is on its way
prep.ui.empty.body: The daily prompts are still being written. Your salah and Quran check-ins already work.
prep.ui.empty.dayTitle: No prompts for this day yet
prep.ui.settings.retakeSub: Update your focus areas. Your progress is kept.
prep.ui.settings.restartSub: Clear your ticks and begin again
prep.ui.settings.how: Readiness adds up your readiness check (40%), the prompts you have done out of those on the days before today (40%; ticking today's prompts can make up for a missed one) and your prayers on time over the last 7 days (20%). Earlier days without a salah check-in count as none on time; today counts once you check in. Until a part has something to count, your readiness check stands in for it.
prep.ui.restart.title: Restart your prep?
prep.ui.restart.body: Your ticked prompts are cleared and the plan begins again. Your reflections, check-ins and readiness check are kept.
prep.ui.restart.bodyShaban: Your ticks are cleared and the plan continues from today, day {n}. Your reflections, check-ins and readiness check are kept.
prep.ui.restart.done: Your plan has restarted at day {n}
prep.ui.toast.allSalah: All five prayers on time today
prep.ui.toast.complete: Your Ramadan prep is complete. May Allah let you reach Ramadan.
prep.ui.toast.completePartial: You reached the last day of your prep. May Allah let you reach Ramadan.
